LanguageData.MST.isCompQualityComment: Whether the item is affected by quality. Suggestion: Do not modify this after starting a game. Changing it during gameplay will not strip quality from existing items; it will only affect whether newly generated items have quality.
LanguageData.MST.equipPowerComment: A value used to quantify equipment strength, calculated solely from panel stats and does not consider any additional mechanics. The value is for reference only.
LanguageData.MST.normalMarketValueComment: The value calculated based on the crafting material and work amount. Not applicable to items that cannot be crafted.
LanguageData.MST.careIfWornByCorpseComment: Whether pawns care if this apparel was worn by a corpse. Affects mood penalty from wearing dead people's clothes.
LanguageData.MST.careIfDamagedComment: Whether pawns care about the condition of this apparel. Affects mood penalty from wearing tattered apparel.
LanguageData.MST.developmentalStageFilterComment: Which developmental stages can wear this apparel. Newborn/Baby/Child/Adult.
LanguageData.MST.stuffCategoriesComment: Which categories of materials can be used to craft this item. Affects available materials when selecting Bills.
LanguageData.MST.researchPrerequisitesComment: Research projects required to unlock this item's construction.
LanguageData.MST.removeReloadableCompComment: Enable to remove the reloadable component. This component cannot be added via this editor.
LanguageData.MST.reloadableAmmoCountToRefillComment: Fixed amount of ammo consumed to fully refill all charges. Set this OR ammoCountPerCharge, not both.
LanguageData.MST.reloadableAmmoCountPerChargeComment: Ammo consumed per charge restored. Set this OR ammoCountToRefill, not both.
LanguageData.MST.reloadableBaseReloadTicksComment: Base reload time in ticks (1/60 sec). Also used as the cooldown duration when replenishAfterCooldown is enabled.
LanguageData.MST.reloadableReplenishAfterCooldownComm: If enabled, charges automatically replenish after a cooldown instead of requiring manual reload.
LanguageData.MST.reloadableMaxChargesComment: Maximum number of charges this apparel can hold.
